lines: The application window for the USF STEM Fellowship 2026 - 2028 is now Open! Click here to Apply.

is Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics integrated into project based learning. It is an interdisciplinary approach based on real world challenges which inculcates critical thinking and problem solving skills in children.

Universe Simplified Foundation (USF) sets up low-cost, portable, STEM based Innovation Hubs in highly under-resourced Government schools in villages on the outskirts of Mumbai. They aim to ensure that every student receives an equal opportunity for inquiry-driven STEM at par with elite schools (which form < 0.1% of all schools in India).

is a full time, two year immersive fellowship during which the fellow works as a STEM educator in rural village schools. In addition to being trained in technical skills, the fellows gain an understanding of how students learn through project and problem based learning methodologies.
Roles & Responsibilities of the STEM Fellow:
Working directly with the children and facilitating hands-on, inquiry driven STEM workshops for grades 8 & 9.
Program execution and operations for the assigned Innovation Hubs.
Engaging the stakeholders (parents, teachers, and communities) by conducting regular meetings and doing home visits.
Taking ownership of their own growth and learning.
This is not an exhaustive list.
Facilitating sessions for students in inquiry driven STEM curriculum
Program execution, planning, and time management
Technical skills as per program requirement (mechanical project making or computer technology)
Education qualification: Preference for science, IT, engineering backgrounds.
Monthly Stipend - First year: INR 20,000; Second year: INR 22,500
Location - Vaholi village, Maharashtra, India (An hour from Kalyan)
